rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a fresh surgical cut when you are speaking about it as a wound.

example.english: The doctor said this incision needs to be cleaned every day, or it could easily become inflamed.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢個傷口要每日洗乾淨，唔係好易發炎。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ni1 go3 soeng1 hau2 jiu3 mui5 jat6 sai2 gon1 zeng6 m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 faat3 jim4

rows.note: Use this for the scar left after the incision has healed, rather than for the fresh cut itself.

example.english: A few months after the operation, the incision scar has faded a lot.
example.traditional: 做完手術幾個月，條疤已經淡咗好多。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 gei2 go3 jyut6 tiu4 baa1 ji5 ging1 daam6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this technical medical term when you mean the incision itself rather than the resulting wound or scar.

example.english: The surgical report states that the incision is on the right side of the abdomen.
example.traditional: 手術報告寫明切口位於腹部右側。
example.jyutping: sau2 seot6 bou3 gou3 se2 ming4 cit3 hau2 wai6 jyu1 fuk1 bou6 jau6 zak1
